title: ExGrad: Beyond Suppression - Explicit Clean-Gradient Subtraction in Adversarial Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.30018v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Adversarial training derives updates from surrogate losses, but source-loss descent does not directly characterize an update's effect on adversarial margins. We introduce ExGrad (extrapolative gradient recomposition), which constructs clean-input, adversarial-input, and adversarial-weight-perturbed (AWP) gradients. Virtual steps measure their margin responses, and a globally solvable three-variable problem selects coefficients over a bounded affine domain without nonnegativity constraints. Across affine radii on CIFAR-10, negative clean coefficients rapidly predominate and increase in magnitude with the radius. Cross-zero interventions show that setting the clean coefficient to zero is insufficient: mild subtraction improves PGD-20, while stronger subtraction trades clean accuracy for further PGD-20 gains. translated_title: ExGrad：超越抑制——对抗训练中的显式干净梯度减除
translated_abstract: 对抗训练从代理损失中导出更新，但源损失的下降并不能直接刻画一个更新对对抗裕度的影响。我们提出 ExGrad（外推梯度重组），该方法构建干净输入梯度、对抗输入梯度和对抗权重扰动（AWP）梯度三类梯度。通过虚拟步骤测量它们对裕度的响应，并以一个全局可解的三变量问题在受限仿射域上选取系数，且不施加非负性约束。在 CIFAR-10 的不同仿射半径下，负的干净系数迅速占据主导地位，且其幅值随半径增大而增加。跨零干预实验表明，仅仅将干净系数设为零是不够的：轻度减除即可提升 PGD-20 鲁棒性，而更强的减除则以牺牲干净准确率为代价换取 PGD-20 的进一步提升。在 CIFAR-10 的 WRN-28-4 对照实验中，三种候选梯度移除变体均无法匹敌完整的 ExGrad。投影诊断显示……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: ExGrad 通过显式构建干净、对抗与 AWP 三类梯度并用全局可解的三变量优化进行重组，证明在对抗训练中对干净梯度进行适度减除（而非单纯抑制或置零）能够显著提升 PGD-20 鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: ExGrad explicitly constructs clean, adversarial, and AWP gradients and recombines them via a globally solvable three-variable optimization, showing that moderately subtracting—rather than merely suppressing or zeroing—clean gradients substantially improves PGD-20 robustness in adversarial training.
